description: Request for 10 kOhm 1 percent thick film resistor for sensor bias network.
pca_remarks: PCA reviewed parametric need and confirmed existing 5 percent part is not equivalent.
comments: Use for low noise divider on Rev C controller board.

description: Request for 4.7 uF 25 V X7R ceramic capacitor for input filtering.
pca_remarks: Library checked voltage derating and package footprint.
comments: Required for input filter on sensor hub main board.

description: Request for 22 uH shielded inductor for buck converter evaluation.
pca_remarks: Pending DCR comparison against existing 18 uH inductor.
supply_risk: Medium - quote and availability under review
alternate_status: Alternates proposed but not yet validated
comments: Needed for regulator efficiency test on prototype units.

description: Request for 12 position right angle board header for service cable interface.
pca_remarks: Awaiting PCA assignment for connector family review.
comments: Service cable requires side entry to meet enclosure clearance.

description: Request for 6 mm tactile switch with 160 gf actuation force for panel reset input.
pca_remarks: Duplicate found during PCA review.
rejection_reason: Requested tact switch duplicates existing approved SWT-000274 and lacks life cycle evidence.

alternate_status: Alternate review stopped due duplicate item
comments: Requester should use existing released switch unless a force tolerance exception is approved.

description: New four layer control PCB bare board for compact sensor hub assembly.

alternate_status: Board outline and two alternates available

description: Brushless DC motor 24 V for automated test fixture axis drive.
pca_remarks: Motor torque curve review is pending.
package_detail: 42 mm flange BLDC motor with encoder

comments: Fixture design requires encoder feedback for repeatable positioning.

description: Planetary gear assembly 10 to 1 ratio for enclosure latch actuator.
pca_remarks: Mechanical review confirmed torque margin and mounting compatibility.
alternate_status: Approved alternate gear ratio options documented

description: Request for 608ZZ sealed bearing for conveyor guide roller replacement.
pca_remarks: PCA confirmed bearing dimensions match existing roller drawing.
package_detail: 8 mm ID 22 mm OD sealed ball bearing

description: M3 x 8 stainless steel pan head screw for revised mounting bracket.
pca_remarks: Thread engagement and finish requirements are under review.

comments: Manufacturing requested common fastener to simplify workstation kitting.

description: Molded enclosure set for compact sensor hub field trial units.
pca_remarks: PCA approved fit requirement and requested mechanical library package.
package_detail: 145 x 90 x 45 mm ABS enclosure with gasket

description: Cable harness for 12 position control panel to sensor board interconnect.

description: DIN rail 24 V 150 W power supply for control cabinet prototype.

description: Nine axis IMU sensor module for motion monitoring option board.
pca_remarks: Electrical and firmware teams confirmed interface support.

description: Seven inch HMI control panel assembly for pilot line operator station.

description: Installation guide for compact sensor hub mounting and wiring instructions.
pca_remarks: Document control is verifying template and applicability scope.

description: Burn in test procedure for sensor hub power and communications validation.

description: Declaration of conformity certificate package for compact sensor hub release.

description: User manual for control panel setup and diagnostic screen navigation.
pca_remarks: Initial document request logged for editorial review.

comments: Manual needed before customer pilot shipment.

description: Secure bootloader package for STM32 based controller board.

description: Windows configuration utility for sensor hub network setup and diagnostics.

description: Retail carton for compact sensor hub starter kit pilot packaging.

description: Protective foam insert set for sensor hub and accessory retention in carton.
